optimizedContext.value:
# GetGraphHealth
## Rules
### Returns enriched graph health
- `GetGraphHealth.execute(input)` → `GetGraphHealthResult` = all `GraphStatistics` +
  - `stale: boolean | null` — per `code-graph:staleness-detection`
  - `currentRef: string | null` — `createVcsAdapter(config.projectRoot)` or null
  - `fingerprintMismatch: boolean | null` — when workspaces + `codeGraphVersion` allow, else null

### Provider-owned availability and error propagation
- Availability via `provider.getStatistics()` only
- MUST NOT call external lock helpers or accept lock-assertion escape hatch
- Busy/stale provider errors propagate unchanged

### Computes VCS staleness
- Resolve ref via `createVcsAdapter`; apply `isGraphStale(lastIndexedRef, currentRef)`
- `lastIndexedRef === null` → `stale: null` (not true)

### Computes derivation fingerprint mismatch
- If `input.workspaces` + `stats.graphFingerprint != null`: parse map, build effective graph config from `input.config`, call `detectFingerprintMismatch` with `codeGraphVersion`, `projectRoot`, workspaces, graph config
- Else `fingerprintMismatch: null`

### Accepts open provider and project inputs
- `GetGraphHealthInput`: `config: SpecdConfig`, `provider: CodeGraphProvider` (open), `codeGraphVersion: string`, optional workspaces
- MUST NOT open/close provider

### Factory wires dependencies
- `createGetGraphHealth()` → stateless instance; no config capture; all inputs per `execute()`

## Constraints
- MUST NOT mutate store or trigger indexing
- MUST NOT load change entities or compile project context
- Statistics via `provider.getStatistics()` only
